topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I remember the day I planted that sapling, my hands small and eager, the soil rough and cool. Years have passed, and that little tree became a towering presence, a silent witness to the chapters of my life. To find it gone, the space empty, it stirs a peculiar sensation. Yet, amidst this, there’s a lightness, a clarity. The tree, though no longer standing, has left behind more than just its absence. It’s a reminder of what once was, and the cycles of growth and change that continue, unyielding. I smile at the memories, at the lessons learned under its shadow. Even in its absence, it teaches.
